latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of bifrost-slpx-info skill.
- Query Bifrost SLPx liquid staking protocol data (vETH) on Ethereum, Base, Optimism, and Arbitrum.
- Provides exchange rates, APY/yield, TVL, protocol stats, user balances, and withdrawal queue status.
- Supports both on-chain ERC-4626 vault calls and Bifrost REST API queries.
- Easy configuration for custom chain, RPC, or contract address; sensible defaults provided.
- Includes examples and quick reference for common queries (rates, balances, protocol metrics).
